description: R4 shell: tray, accessory policy, skipped hotkeys, and a verified blurred pop-up panel opened by the capture hotkey path and by open_view
notes: Automation instances run with UBILINK_SKIP_HOTKEYS=1 (O4), so this asserts hotkeys_skipped and an empty hotkeys_registered; the three real registrations are the maintainer's manual R4 check.
The tray is created whether or not hotkeys are skipped, so tray_present is asserted for real.
window_kind/background stay 'unknown' and window_verified false until a live panel is read back; step 1 pins that, so the later 'popup'/'blurred' cannot be a default.

material (D26) names what is behind the panel's content, read back from the live window's subviews: 'glass' (an NSGlassEffectView, macOS 26+), 'vibrancy' (GPUI's NSVisualEffectView, the fallback on older systems) or 'unknown' before a panel is read. This host runs macOS 27, so 'glass' is asserted.
data_dir is what the app's one resolver (desktop-gpui/src/paths.rs) returns: it must be this instance's own {data_dir}, never the user's Application Support dir.

steps.name: the other view is not rendered
